questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that the road curves right first, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws. You must obey them. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services. They tell you where to find rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other helpful services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs, cones, and barrels mark work zones. Stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control. Stay calm and ease back onto the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers they must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk ahead. When you see it, be alert and allow pedestrians to cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: This round sign marks a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a winding road with three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic and only complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Slow down and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed where you cannot enter. You may see it on one-way streets or if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, let other traffic and pedestrians go if they have the right-of-way, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop for other drivers or pedestrians. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people who have disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.
